inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala is urging people to reject the proposed amendments, but that doesn’t prove they are an assault on the public. Zimbabwe should handle constitutional questions through lawful institutions and open debate, not political alarmism. Stability and respect for established authority matter too; any changes should be judged on their merits, not dismissed on the assumption that they are simply a scheme to keep Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030.
